# FG-CI-0018

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`ci-secrets`](../../ops/runbooks/ci-secrets.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_job_asking_for_an_undefined_secret_fails` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: ジョブが求めたシークレットがプロジェクトに登録されていません。ジョブは失敗にしました。
- en: A secret the job asked for is not defined in the project. The job was failed.
- id: Rahasia yang diminta tugas tidak terdaftar di proyek. Tugas digagalkan.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C6: a job of a protected push pipeline names a secret (`secrets:` in `.forge-ci.yml`) that has no CI variable of that name in the project (never set, or deleted since). The job is failed in the claim's place rather than run without it (a script that silently gets an empty value could deploy or publish wrongly).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

`forge serve` logs `forge.ci.secret_not_defined` (info) with `error_code`, `request_id`, `job_id`, `pipeline_id`, `project_id` and `missing` (the names). `gstn ci variable list --project <id>` lists what is defined (names and flags only).

## 対処 (fix)

Set the variable (Maintainer: gstn ci variable set --project <id> <NAME>, the value on standard input) or remove the name from the job's `secrets:`, then retry the pipeline (gstn pipeline retry).
